Shipping companies and airlines may need to take alternative routes or implement additional security measures to mitigate the risk of attack or disruption. ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Airlines are expected to tighten rules on power banks, potentially leading to increased scrutiny of passenger carry-on items and checked luggage.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: The focus on power bank safety may lead to more stringent regulations and increased awareness among travelers, reducing the risk of in-flight fires over the long term.
